entities.name: Daniel Jiménez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Daniel Jiménez Román is a Puerto Rican former professional boxer who competed from 1988 to 2002. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the World Boxing Organization (WBO) junior featherweight title from 1993 to 1995 and the WBO bantamweight title from 1995 to 1996.
